summary: This audit stage conducted an exceptionally thorough static audit of the paper and repository notebook across 395 cells and all shipped seed-word files. It identified key methodological discrepancies including the use of LinearSVC instead of LDA, missing code for three evaluation blocks, the doPCA precedence bug, MWEAT dot products, and severe noun-list label noise. The work maintained rigorous calibration and adversarial verification between researcher notes and verifier logs without making unhedged false claims. While it uncovered numerous fine-grained implementation bugs, it did not catch deeper validity issues such as the permutation p-value tie mechanism or circular evaluation.
